mode: async integration with local data/ownership invariants
stack: Python stdlib + SQLite; synthetic preauthenticated event boundary; caller-owned connection.
contract: Accepted synthetic states pending -> paid -> refunded. Late pending and paid after refund are unchanged. Refund before payment is retryable and unconsumed. Event IDs bind immutable fields; fulfilled order IDs uniquely constrain effects. Target order must exist and persisted tenant must match event tenant.
fix: SAVEPOINT couples receipt, conditional transition and fulfillment; failures roll back event work, and any outer transaction remains caller-owned.
verification: 8 boundary tests; all 8 fail before and pass after. Demo changes from pending/2 fulfillments to paid/1. Triggered effect failure rolls back receipt/state and retry succeeds.
recovery: Only copied scratch schema changed. Discard scratch DB to revert; existing persisted DB migration is not implemented. Refund is local state only, not an external refund.
limitations: Provider signature/authentication intentionally a trusted precondition, not implemented or verified.
Model has no amount/currency/provider-account fields; production reconciliation and multi-provider scope are unverified.
Concurrent connections/processes and external fulfillment delivery remain unverified.
A valid refund requires retry after a paid event; no durable reconciliation queue is implemented.
